title: Implement Breezily, silent aim, and regression fixes
objective: Implement the approved SpeedBridge Assist technique framework, repair the stale staircase crash and backward movement regression, add shared visible/silent aim, implement authentic Breezily and Automatic selection, and verify the result on Java 25 and Minecraft 26.2.
acceptance_criteria: The stale staircase placement result sequence cannot reactivate a reset cycle or dereference a null PathStep
Physical backward input remains on the committed bridge axis while visible placement aim changes player yaw
The reusable technique and correlated placement contracts compile and pass their deterministic tests
Java 25 Gradle tests and a clean Fabric production build pass on Minecraft 26.2
Visible and silent aim preserve normal movement packet cadence and ordinary block interaction
Forced Breezily never falls back to another technique and aborts safely when invalid
Automatic selects only eligible techniques at safe transition boundaries
All synthetic input, rotation, placement, and technique ownership is released on every exit path
